# E0 Finder (https://e0-finder.app)
> India-focused E0 petrol, XP100, poWer100 and non-E20 petrol station discovery for Android and web.

## Summary
E0 Finder is an independent mobile app and website that helps Indian motorists search reported E0 petrol and high-octane petrol station signals. The site is designed for practical searches such as "E0 fuel finder", "ethanol-free petrol near me", "XP100 petrol near me", "poWer100 petrol pump" and "non-E20 petrol station".

## App Identity
- Website: https://e0-finder.app
- Android package used by this website: com.anupampradhan.ethanolfreepetrol
- Google Play link format: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.anupampradhan.ethanolfreepetrol
- Support email: support@e0-finder.app

## Trust and Methodology
- Station listings are reports, not permanent certificates of fuel composition or current tank stock.
- Users should check product name, report date, evidence notes and outlet confirmation before travelling.
- E0 Finder is not an oil marketing company and is not affiliated with government agencies.
- Methodology page: https://e0-finder.app/methodology
- About page: https://e0-finder.app/about
- Download page: https://e0-finder.app/download

## Current Fuel Context
India has reached national E20 blending, while premium petrol products such as IndianOil XP100 and HPCL poWer100 are positioned by their official product pages as 100-octane fuels. E0 Finder helps users discover station-level reports and should be used with outlet confirmation for current availability.
